description_en: Submits a media transcoding job to start asynchronous transcoding
description_zh: 调用本接口提交媒体转码作业，开始异步转码处理
kebab_example: aliyun vod submit-transcode-jobs --video-id 142710f878bd42508932f660d7b10000 --template-group-id 0e408c803baf658ee637790c5d9f0000 --pipeline-id d3e680e618708erf45fbf2cae7c0000 --encrypt-config CipherText_:_ZjJmZGViNzUtZWY1Mi00Y2RlLTk30000_,_DecryptKeyUri_:_http://demo.aliyundoc.com0CipherText=ZjJmZGViNzUtZWY1Mi00Y2RlLTk30000_,_KeyServiceType_:_KMS --override-params Watermarks_:_WatermarkId_:_af2afe4761992c47dae9733740000_,_FileUrl_:_http://developer.aliyundoc.com/image/image.png_,_WatermarkId_:_e8e5b8038d7ada85b376c27070000_,_Content_:_watermark_test --priority 6 --user-data Extend_:_localId_:_0000_,_test_:_000 --session-id 5c62d40299034bbaa4c195da3300000 --reference-id 123-123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitTranscodeJobs

parameters.description_en:
The video ID. You can obtain the video ID by using one of the following methods:
- Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the video ID.
- Obtain the value of VideoId from the response to the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation.
- After the video is uploaded, call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the video ID. The video ID is the value of VideoId in the response.
parameters.description_zh:
视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过控制台上传的视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看视频ID。
- 通过[CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~)接口上传视频时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 视频上传后，可通过[SearchMedia](~~86044~~)接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。

parameters.description_en:
The encryption configuration. This parameter is a JSON string and is required only when you use HLS encryption.

> - The **CipherText** parameter in the [EncryptConfig](~~86952~~) struct must be an AES_128 ciphertext key generated by calling [GenerateKMSDataKey](~~455051~~). Otherwise, HLS encryption transcoding fails. For more information about the HLS encryption process, see [HLS encryption](~~68612~~).
> - Regardless of whether you use HLS encryption or proprietary encryption, the templates associated with **TemplateGroupId** must have the HLS encryption option selected. Otherwise, the content is not encrypted.
parameters.description_zh:
加密配置，为JSON字符串，只有使用HLS标准加密时才需要此参数。

> - [EncryptConfig](~~86952~~)结构体中**CipherText**参数必须为通过[GenerateKMSDataKey](~~455051~~)生成的AES_128密文密钥，否则标准加密转码失败。标准加密接入流程，请参见[HLS标准加密](~~68612~~)。
> - 无论标准加密、私有加密，**TemplateGroupId**对应的模板数据，必须都勾选HLS加密选项，否则不加密。

parameters.description_en:
The priority of the current transcoding job among all queued jobs.

- Valid values: **1** to **10**.
- Highest priority: **10**.
- Default value: **6**.

> The Priority parameter affects only the priority of the current transcoding job among all queued jobs. It does not affect jobs that are already being transcoded.
parameters.description_zh:
当前发起的转码作业在所有排队作业中的优先级。

- 取值范围：**1**~**10**。
- 最高优先级：**10**。
- 默认值：**6**。

> Priority参数只影响当前发起的转码作业在所有排队状态作业中的优先级，但不影响已经转码处理中的任务优先级。

parameters.description_en:
The custom deduplication identifier. If a request with the same identifier was submitted within the past 7 days, the current request returns an error.
The value can be up to 50 characters in length and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, deduplication is not performed.
parameters.description_zh:
自定义去重识别码，如果7天内曾有过相同的识别码的请求，则本次的请求会返回错误。
长度最长为50个字符，支持大小写英文字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_），不传或者带空字符串表示不去重。
